activity.notes: Athaulf succeeded Alaric I and ruled the Visigoths from 410 to 415, leading the still-mobile Gothic people from Italy into Gaul before his death at Barcelona in 415. ATLAS therefore reuses the existing Visigoths polity rather than anachronistically projecting the later settled Visigothic Kingdom backward onto his entire reign.

sources.citation_text: Deutsche Biographie identifies Athaulf as king of the Visigoths from 410 to 415, successor of Alaric I, and records his movement from Italy into Gaul before his murder in 415.
